description: ClickUp structure for the Vios Marketing department. Recreate in any workspace by asking Claude to 'recreate the ClickUp structure from setup/clickup.json'. Ids below are the personal-account instance created 2026-10-29.

folder.name: Vios Marketing

lists.name: Department — Setup & SOP
lists.content: Department build tasks, onboarding checklists, quarterly reviews.

lists.name: <Client> — Content
lists.content: One task per post. Draft → QA → Approved (qa-log signed) → Scheduled (Metricool) → Published → Reported.

lists.name: <Client> — Engagement
lists.content: Daily triage batches (comments, DMs, reviews). Hard-line 11 escalations carry the facts only.

lists.name: <Client> — Ads
lists.content: Weekly vios-ads-audit action list. Pauses and budget changes need the client owner.

folder.per_client: Create the three <Client> lists for every onboarded client.

per_client_rule: Each client's accounts.md lists its three ClickUp list ids; scheduled tasks read them from there.
